name: SK Target Group Limited
summary: SK Target Group Limited, founded in 1993 and headquartered in Seri Kembangan, Malaysia, is an investment holding company that manufactures and distributes precast concrete junction boxes in Malaysia under the Target brand. The boxes support telecom and electrical infrastructure upgrades and general construction. Besides manufacturing and trading, it has segments for other building materials, Japanese catering and sourcing, and rents mobile cranes to handle its concrete products.
